summaries.zh-Hans: 点一下把最近复制的文本存成文件，首行自动做文件名，同名不覆盖。
summaries.en: One click saves the latest copied text to a file, named from its first line.

descriptions.zh-Hans:
无输入的 shell 动作：点击芯片即读取剪贴板文本并落盘。

- 用 `pbpaste` 取最近一次复制的文本，**原样**写入文件，不加不减
- 文件名默认取文本首行：清掉 `/` `:` 与换行制表符、trim 空白、截到 40 字；首行为空时回落 `剪贴板-年月日-时分秒`
- 同名不覆盖，自动加 `-1` `-2`
- 剪贴板为空、只有空白、或只有图片时报失败，不会产生空文件
- 产物经 `notch_result --output` 上报，可直接从刘海反馈里拖走

参数：

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 保存到 | `~/Desktop` | 留空则用 App 解析的输出位置（`$NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR`），再回落桌面 |
| 文件后缀 | `txt` | `txt` 或 `md` |
| 用首行文本做文件名 | 开 | 关掉则一律用时间戳命名 |

零第三方依赖，只用 macOS 自带的 `pbpaste`。

> 提示：脚本里目标路径变量刻意叫 `dest` 而不是 `path`——zsh 的 `path` 与 `$PATH` 双向绑定，给它赋值会让后续所有外部命令 `command not found`。
descriptions.en:
A no-input shell action: click the chip to read the clipboard and write it to a file.

- Reads the latest copied text with `pbpaste` and writes it **verbatim**, byte for byte
- The filename defaults to the first line: `/`, `:`, newlines and tabs stripped, whitespace trimmed, truncated to 40 characters; falls back to a `剪贴板-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS` timestamp when the first line is empty
- Never overwrites: name clashes get an auto `-1`, `-2` suffix
- Fails cleanly (no empty file) when the clipboard is empty, whitespace-only, or holds no text
- The product is reported via `notch_result --output`, ready to drag away from the notch feedback

Parameters:

| Parameter | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Save to | `~/Desktop` | Leave empty to use the output location resolved by NotchAny (`$NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR`), then the Desktop |
| Extension | `txt` | `txt` or `md` |
| Name from first line | on | Turn off to always use a timestamp |

No third-party dependencies — only the built-in `pbpaste`.

**Note:** this action declares `zh-Hans` only, so its chip name, parameter labels and feedback text are in Chinese.
